XNet - native edition
=====================

Fast, safe networking for Garry's Mod, with the server side encoding in
Rust. Players never download a binary: clients use the Lua edition, which
the server sends them automatically.

Install
-------

1. Extract this zip into your server's "garrysmod" folder. You get:

       garrysmod/addons/xnet/lua/autorun/xnet.lua
       garrysmod/lua/bin/gmsv_xnet_linux.dll     Linux, 32-bit (default srcds)
       garrysmod/lua/bin/gmsv_xnet_linux64.dll   Linux, 64-bit (x86-64 branch)
       garrysmod/lua/bin/gmsv_xnet_win32.dll     Windows, 32-bit
       garrysmod/lua/bin/gmsv_xnet_win64.dll     Windows, 64-bit

   Garry's Mod loads only the one that matches your server. You can delete
   the other three.

2. Restart the server. A binary module that is already loaded is only
   replaced by a restart, not by a map change.

Check it works
--------------

In the server console:

       lua_run print(XNet.Version, XNet.Native, XNetNative and XNetNative.Version)

XNet.Native is true when the module is in use. If it prints false, the
binary for your server is missing from garrysmod/lua/bin (or is the wrong
one), and XNet keeps working in pure Lua.

Use it
------

Exactly like the Lua edition:

       -- server
       XNet.Receive("shop.buy", function(ply, item, amount) end)
       XNet.Send(ply, "inventory.sync", inventory)

       -- client
       XNet.Receive("inventory.sync", function(inventory) end)
       XNet.Send("shop.buy", "weapon_ak47", 2)

Full documentation: https://github.com/exliipso/XNet

Removing it: delete garrysmod/addons/xnet and the gmsv_xnet_*.dll files.

and NOTICE are in garrysmod/addons/xnet/; keep them when you redistribute XNet.
